compiled_state.title: LAURA placeholder: retrieval-anchored exemplar suppression over defense corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context (placeholder)

LAURA (Logged Adversarial-defense Retrieval Anchors) is the retrieval-anchored exemplar suppression pattern from arxiv 2512.01356, operationalizing the defense corpus accumulated by the central telemetry store (Epic e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 umbrella).

## Scope (to be brainstormed)

When a new finding's location proximity-matches a prior defense's accepted-rebuttal evidence in the retrieval store, suppress the finding pre-emergence. Distinct from Story A's proximity matcher (which suppresses recurrence of the same finding across cycles within one PR) — LAURA suppresses recurrence across PRs using the accumulated defense corpus.

## Dependencies

depends_on e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 (umbrella). Cannot be developed until the central telemetry store is live AND has accumulated enough defense records to function as a retrieval corpus. Estimated ≥50 labeled PRs needed before useful.

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>` after the umbrella ships.
